image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja). The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper chest. Key features include the distinctive elongated, flat, spatulate bill which is greyish-green with a darker tip, a bright red eye, and textured white/grey plumage on the head and neck transitioning to vibrant pink feathers on the body. A crest of feathers is visible on the nape.
